biggest_catch: The $200 is a card-plus-checking bundle bonus — you must open an Upgrade Card (credit product, hard inquiry, 14.99%-29.99% APR line) AND a Rewards Checking Preferred account; it is not a checking-only signup bonus.
catches: Requires opening BOTH an Upgrade Card and a Rewards Checking Preferred account as part of the same application process — the card involves a hard credit pull and a 14.99%-29.99% APR credit line.

You must open and fund a new Rewards Checking Preferred account and make 3 qualifying debit card transactions within 60 days of the checking account opening; ATM transactions do not count and transactions must have settled.
Previous Upgrade checking customers are not eligible — new checking customers only.
Your Upgrade Card and Rewards Checking Preferred account must be open and in good standing to receive the bonus.
Welcome bonus offers cannot be combined, substituted, or applied retroactively; this one-time bonus may not be available on other Upgrade Card offers.

Note: Upgrade's help center separately describes an Upgrade Card welcome bonus (spend $200 in select categories + 3 on-time payments within 1 year, credited to the card in 1-2 billing periods) — that is a different offer from this $200 checking+card combo.

steps: Go to the official Upgrade card offer page https://www.upgrade.com/upgrade-card/life-rewards-focus/ and start the Upgrade Card application (checking for an offer first does not impact your credit score; submitting the application does).
As part of the same application process, open and fund a new Rewards Checking Preferred account — opening it separately later disqualifies you from the bonus.
Receive your Rewards Checking Preferred debit card and make 3 qualifying debit card purchases that settle within 60 days of the checking account opening (ATM transactions do not count).
Keep both the Upgrade Card and the Rewards Checking Preferred account open and in good standing.
The $200 bonus is applied to your Rewards Checking Preferred account as a one-time payout credit within 60 days after you meet the conditions.
Pay any Upgrade Card balance in full to avoid the 14.99%-29.99% APR — the bonus does not require carrying a balance.
